title: Possession questions review
focus: Mix the forms and sentence patterns already taught in this pack.

exercises.prompt: Ask and reply: “Do I have a game? I do have it.” Use minulla ("I as owner") and peli ("game"). Owner follows question word. Kyllä means “yes”.
exercises.explanation: First form the question; then echo on to confirm possession or ei ole to deny it.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Possession question short answers: form or meaning confused

sentenceExplanation.translation: Do I have a game? I do have it.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: onko + possessor + one thing in its basic singular form; fixed short reply

parts.formation: On + the yes/no question ending -ko = onko. It stays the same with every possessor.

parts.role: possessor: the person who has the thing
parts.formation: minä has the learned possession form minulla; its -lla/-llä ending marks the possessor. Learn this pronoun form as a whole.
peli stays in its basic singular form: one game.
Kyllä means “yes”; it can introduce the affirmative verb reply.
Echo fixed on: the owner and thing are understood from the question.
